name: grafana
title: Grafana
description: Query dashboards, panels, datasources, alerts and incidents on a Grafana instance. Reaches Grafana with a service account token you supply as a named secret.

params.name: grafana_url
params.description: Base URL of the Grafana instance, including the scheme.

params.name: service_account_token
params.description: Grafana service account token with the scopes you want exposed.

params.name: org_id
params.description: Numeric Grafana organization id, when the token spans more than one organization.

egress.reason: the Grafana instance this server queries
